title: Pause routines for a holiday but keep bank alerts, then resume cleanly
source: x-usage #18: selective pause, bank alerts still work, resume works, nothing double-fires on resume.

chat.goal: Set up three things: a lunchbox idea every school morning at 7, a 6pm 'what's on tomorrow', and tell you straight away about any email from CommBank.
chat.opener: can you set up 3 things: lunchbox idea every school morning at 7, at 6pm tell me whats on tomorrow, and tell me straight away if commbank emails me
chat.label: setup

chat.goal: Pause everything for the holiday except the bank alerts.
chat.opener: we're away on holiday, pause all of them except the bank ones
chat.label: pause

mail.subject: Purchase on your card
mail.body: A purchase of $1,249.00 at JB HI-FI ONLINE was made on your card ending 5521.

chat.goal: Plans changed, you're home; turn everything back on.
chat.opener: change of plans we're home, turn them all back on
chat.label: resume

judge: Rosie pauses the lunchbox and evening routines but keeps the bank watcher, so the $1,249 JB Hi-Fi purchase still gets flagged. On resume everything is back on and Wednesday has exactly one lunchbox idea, no catch-up burst.
